name: Slaver Zokuto
source: A slaver who enslaves humans engages in human trafficking. A member of the demon race. Cooperates with the Taimanin (Anti-demon Ninja) in exchange for not being persecuted.
translation: A slaver who enslaves humans engages in human trafficking. A member of the demon race. Cooperates with the Taimanin (Anti-demon Ninja) in exchange for not being persecuted.
